name: Entity Builder UI
description: Provides YAML editor fallback for Entity Builder definitions with grid provider discovery.
project_description: Entity Builder UI is the browser-based editing layer for the Entity Builder (eb) module and ships inside the eb project (documented release 1.0.0-alpha1, a pre-release). It provides a CodeMirror-enhanced YAML editor form for creating and editing eb_definition entities, a set of shared AJAX API endpoints (validate, preview, list bundles, get entity config) used by all editing front-ends, and a hook-based grid provider discovery system (hook_eb_ui_grid_provider_info) that lets richer editors such as Entity Builder AG-Grid register themselves. When no grid provider is installed, or when the user toggles Source view, the YAML editor is the fallback. CodeMirror 5 is loaded from a CDN; a plain-textarea mode with no external dependencies is also available.
